market.basis: heading names the planning region (a county equivalent); legacy-county composition is an approximation

ct.basis_legacy: approximation from legacy counties; Fairfield County is much wider than this market
ct.fit_legacy: approximate: Greater Bridgeport is only part of Fairfield County; the legacy county overstates it
ct.fit_planning: exact: heading names Greater Bridgeport, the Greater Bridgeport Planning Region

market.reason: Planning region is exact; legacy Fairfield County is only a partial, wider stand-in.

note: Headline values only. SBA FOIA series give the FY2016-2025 window, and a class with no loans in it is left out (zero); CBP leaves out classes with no establishments (zero), and the bundles leave out CBP employment and establishments per 10,000 residents. The series files under data/markets/series/ hold every window, year and series.

all.note: moe-approximated (root sum of squares of component MOEs)
